traits.note: Mabberley's Plant-book (4th ed., 2017), under Pteridaceae: terrestrial ferns, mostly small, a few aquatic (Ceratopteris); fronds mostly pinnate, simple in the vittarioids; sporangia in lines along the veins without indusium, or at the margin under the margin turned back as a false indusium (maidenhairs, brakes, lip ferns).
